observation: Critique-before-code prevented hardcoded rgba(44,36,26,0.02) propagating into TSX. Both design-critique (Round 1, 8/10) and architecture-critique (Round 1, 8/10) independently flagged AQ-008/AQ-018 violation. Designer revised approved.md to restate hover as color-mix token form. Builder used clickableProps (token hover) instead of rgba literal. Pattern: two-round design+arch critique system is load-bearing for cross-cutting design rules.

TDD red phase locked all AC detail (6 test files, 84+ tests covering AC-1..6, migration-integrity, protected-test preservation). All 73 tests green on first green-phase run (03c11eff). Single green commit delivered 7 components + 2 migrations + 849 LOC tests. No test-writing debt. Pattern: tight contract (AC→task map, design-it-twice, critique rounds) enables clean green execution.

AC-6 (Playwright capture spec) was an explicit task (T10) but skipped in red/green phases. Listed in architecture.md; no *.spec.ts created. Code review found missing and marked C2 (CRITICAL). Builder added 355 LOC AG6-row-primitive.spec.ts in fix commit. Root cause: AC-6 is E2E/proof (different from unit-contract ACs 1-5). When red-phase TDD focuses on unit tests, E2E ACs can be invisible. Remedy: segregate E2E ACs in architecture template or flag them separately ('AC-6 E2E DELIVERABLE'); red phase should have AC checklist marking unit vs E2E.

W2 (non-uniform hover/focus across Row wrapper branches): plan stated 'hover+focus+motion sourced from clickableProps' but first implementation (03c11eff) had only 1 of 4 interactive branches (div+actions ~30%) applying hover/focus. Button and li branches had zero hover. Violated AC-3 ('one consistent hover/focus') — the primitive's headline contract. Root cause: plan specified pattern but didn't enforce structurally; red tests asserted hover exists but not on every branch variant. Cost: 1 code-review warning (W2), 1 fix commit. Remedy: design-system primitives with multiple wrapper branches need explicit wrapper-branch matrix test asserting hover/focus on every interactive variant.

C1 (visual regression: lead-marker literal quote glyphs ' — Lead' rendered as '" — Lead"') not caught by TDD because red-phase fixtures used isLead:false. TDD validates unit contracts and common paths; visual regressions and edge-case fixture gaps need code review + visual inspection. Code review (C1, CRITICAL) caught it; builder added isLead:true fixture + regression test. Pattern: orthogonal lenses (unit TDD + visual review) are both load-bearing.

W3 (missing doc-check justification) in commit 03c11eff. Commit body had no 'doc-check:' line. Convention: every commit either updates DESIGN.md or includes one-line justification. Code review (W3, WARNING) flagged it. Builder fix (2d97adde) added justification line. Root cause: commit-message checklist is not automated; builder shipped before review. Recurring pattern (3+ workpackages: AI1, AI3, AI4, AG6). Remedy: pre-commit hook or CI gate validating doc-check line in commit body. Implementation cost ~1h.

Pipeline cost: Phase 1 (design sketch) minimal. Phase 2 (2-round critique: design 8→9/10, arch 8→9/10, designer revision 1 commit) = tight loop. Phase 3 (red: 84+ tests; green: 1 commit, all green first run) = TDD discipline. Phase 4 (review: 2 CRITICAL + 3 WARNING; fix: 1 commit addressing all 5; re-review: DONE) = visible rework. Total: 11 commits, 5 phases, ~8h elapsed single session. Rework: 1 code-review cycle. Cost driver: AC-6 (E2E spec) and wrapper-branch-matrix test gaps in red phase preventable upfront.
